name: Earnings Beat vs Miss: 30-Day Forward Returns
description: Compares AAPL, MSFT, NVDA, and GOOGL 30-day forward log returns after earnings beats (EPS surprise > 0) vs misses (EPS surprise <= 0). Includes cross-sectional boxplot (Beat vs Miss per asset), event markers on each earnings date, and a summary table with avg/median returns, hit rates, and event counts.
source:
# --- Earnings Beat vs Miss: 30-Day Forward Log Returns ---
# Classifies each earnings event as Beat or Miss, computes 30-day forward
# log return, and compares distributions across AAPL, MSFT, NVDA, GOOGL.

# --- Data ---
src = study_assets()
earn = earnings()
ts = index().value

# --- Earnings Classification ---
# eps_surprise_percent is non-null only on earnings dates
is_earnings = is_valid(earn.eps_surprise_percent)
is_beat = earn.eps_surprise_percent > 0
is_miss = is_earnings and not is_beat

# --- Forward 30-Day Log Return ---
# ln(price_30d_ahead / price_today)
fwd_log_ret = ln(src.c << 30) - ln(src.c)

# --- Filtered Series for Beat vs Miss ---
beat_ret = where(is_beat, fwd_log_ret)
miss_ret = where(is_miss, fwd_log_ret)

# --- Beat/Miss Label (string) ---
event_label = conditional_select(is_beat, "Beat", is_miss, "Miss", "N/A")

# --- Boxplot: Beat vs Miss per Asset ---
# Variadic mode: 2 boxes side-by-side (Beat, Miss) per asset chart
boxplot(
    mode=BoxplotMode.variadic,
    title='Do Earnings Beats Lead to Better 30-Day Returns?',
    series_names=['Beat', 'Miss'],
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    y_axis_label='30-Day Forward Log Return',
    category='Earnings Analysis',
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, title='Zero', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    colors=[Color.Blue, Color.Gray],
    outlier_color=Color.Red
)(values=(beat_ret, miss_ret))

# --- Event Markers: Every Earnings Date ---
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='Earnings Release',
        icon=Icon.TargetIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Result', type=CardRenderType.TextFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.PrimaryBadge),
            ColumnSpec(title='EPS Surprise', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Hero),
            ColumnSpec(title='Actual EPS', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Details),
            ColumnSpec(title='Estimated EPS', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Details),
            ColumnSpec(title='30d Fwd Return', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Details),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    )
)(event_label, earn.eps_surprise_percent, earn.actual_eps, earn.estimated_eps, fwd_log_ret, is_earnings)

# --- Summary Table: Per-Asset Earnings Statistics ---
# Hit rate = fraction of events with positive 30d return
beat_hit = where(is_beat, 1.0 if fwd_log_ret > 0 else 0.0)
miss_hit = where(is_miss, 1.0 if fwd_log_ret > 0 else 0.0)

cs_summary_table(
    title='Earnings Reaction: Beat vs Miss Summary',
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    category='Earnings Analysis',
    order=1,
    schema=TableReportSchema(
        title='Earnings Reaction Summary',
        include_timestamp=False,
        columns=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Avg 30d Ret (Beat)', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='Avg 30d Ret (Miss)', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='Med 30d Ret (Beat)', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2,
                       grid_agg=AggregationType.Median),
            ColumnSpec(title='Med 30d Ret (Miss)', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2,
                       grid_agg=AggregationType.Median),
            ColumnSpec(title='Beat Hit Rate', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(title='Miss Hit Rate', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(title='# Beats', type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat,
                       grid_agg=AggregationType.Count),
            ColumnSpec(title='# Misses', type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat,
                       grid_agg=AggregationType.Count)
        ]
    )
)(beat_ret, miss_ret, beat_ret, miss_ret, beat_hit, miss_hit, beat_ret, miss_ret)
